documents.query: SELECT row_to_json(d) FROM documents d WHERE kind IN ('definition','state','alarm','revision','entity','data_catalog') ORDER BY kind,id

observations.query: SELECT row_to_json(o) FROM observations o ORDER BY device_id,key,observed_ms,id

latest.query: SELECT row_to_json(l) FROM latest l ORDER BY device_id,key

rollups.query: SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM rollups r ORDER BY device_id,key
